description: EXPERIMENTAL: written from Loki's documented HTTP API and tested against recorded and mock responses, not yet against a real Loki, so it may not work as is. Searches logs with LogQL and lists the labels to build a query from, read-only (Grafana Loki, Grafana Cloud Logs). Off until an environment sets it up.

baseUrl.description: The Loki URL, e.g. http://loki.internal:3100 (Grafana Cloud: the URL of your Logs instance); a path prefix is kept

authorization.description: The whole Authorization header, if it needs one: 'Bearer <token>' or 'Basic <base64 of user:token>'

orgId.description: The tenant, sent as X-Scope-OrgID, when Loki is multi-tenant

searchLogs.description: Search logs with a LogQL query such as {service="payments"} |= "503" or {app="shop"} | json | level="error", over a time range, oldest first, with their labels and times. Use labels first when you do not know the label names. Read-only. Experimental: not verified against a live Loki.

query.description: A LogQL query: a stream selector in braces, optionally with filters

from.description: Start: ISO 8601 or relative like now-15m (default now-1h)

limit.description: Most lines to return, up to 100

newest.description: Newest first instead of oldest first

labels.description: The label names Loki knows, or the values of one label (service, app, level ...), to build a LogQL selector from. Read-only. Experimental: not verified against a live Loki.

name.description: A label name: its values are returned. Without it, the label names.
